summary: Recursively deletes files under a directory path. Validates the path argument, normalizes a trailing backslash (word_5C2AAC), appends a file search pattern pointed to by dword_5C2AB8 to the path, then enumerates with FindFirstFileA/FindNextFileA. For each file entry it clears the read-only attribute (ToggleFileReadOnlyAttributeViaWin32API) and deletes it (FileDeleteWithErrorHandling); the first successful file deletion aborts the whole walk and returns false. Directory entries (dwFileAttributes & 0x10) are skipped when they are ".." or match word_5BEB48, otherwise the function recurses into the subdirectory. When enumeration ends without a successful deletion, the handle is closed and the function returns (sub_59B9F3(path) == 0). Called by ProfileAlreadyExistsPageHandler (0x0046CB50), consistent with profile/save scene file cleanup.

local_names.v6: strcmp result of cFileName against skip-name word_5BEB48

operations.description: Return false when the path argument is null or empty (strlen == 0).
Return false when the path length (strlen + 1) reaches the 1024-byte FileName buffer limit.
Append the backslash separator word_5C2AAC to the path when it does not already end in a backslash.
Copy the normalized directory path into the v12 prefix buffer so the directory part survives search-pattern append.
Append the file search pattern pointed to by dword_5C2AB8 (dword read at strlen offset) to FileName to form the FindFirstFileA search path.
Call FindFirstFileA(FileName, &FindFileData) to begin directory enumeration with the constructed pattern.
Return false when FindFirstFileA returns INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE (no matches or invalid path).
Iterate over search results via FindNextFileA until enumeration is exhausted.
Build the full entry path v11 with StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck(v11, "%s%s", v12, cFileName) using the "%s%s" format string at 0x005BE860.
Branch to directory handling when dwFileAttributes has FILE_ATTRIBUTE_DIRECTORY (0x10) set.
Clear the read-only attribute on the file via ToggleFileReadOnlyAttributeViaWin32API(v11, 128) before deletion.
A successful file deletion aborts the entire walk: close the find handle and return false.
For directory entries, skip ".." and the name matching word_5BEB48 (strcmp); otherwise recurse into the subdirectory.
Recursive self-call sub_499690(v11) on the subdirectory full path; a nonzero result continues enumeration, a zero result aborts the walk and returns false.
Close the enumeration handle with FindClose when the loop ends.
On exhaustion without a successful deletion, call sub_59B9F3(v1) on the original path and return (sub_59B9F3(v1) == 0).
Return false on every early-exit path (null/empty path, oversized path, FindFirstFileA failure, immediate successful file delete, recursion abort).
